title: ExplorerTranslationsScreen
responsibility: Compares revision-scoped English strings with a selected language and links to their runtime consumers.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Available project branches and revisions used by the shared explorer frame.

inputs.name: head
inputs.description: Selected revision shown by the shared navigation and revision controls.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.description: First parent for selected-commit comparisons; null at branch tip or without a parent.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Selected branch, commit and resolved address for scoped navigation.

inputs.name: route
inputs.description: Current Translations address, including its selected branch and optional commit.

inputs.name: entities
inputs.description: Revision-scoped entity catalog supplied to the shared explorer frame.

inputs.name: lens
inputs.description: Host readers for entity contracts, measurements and captured evidence.

inputs.name: client
inputs.description: Loads revision data when the shared frame needs historical navigation.

inputs.name: mediaBase
inputs.description: Base URL from which the shared frame resolves captured media.

inputs.name: onroute
inputs.description: Requests navigation while preserving the selected explorer scope.

inputs.name: exportHref
inputs.description: Project export URL; empty when the host provides no export.

outputs.name: ExplorerTranslationsScreen
outputs.description: Compares English with the selected language, with search, paging and links to recorded consumers.
